Odegaard was the match-winner again for Arsenal on Wednesday, thumping in the only goal of the game in the Champions League victory at Napoli. That hit followed his clinching strike against Chelsea in the Premier League on Sunday and takes his total to four goals in five appearances this season across all competitions. Odegaard only scored once for Arsenal during an injury-hit 2025/26 campaign but now his stats are up across a range of other attacking metrics, too. It was a horrible start for 2023 champion Gauff, whose serve and forehand deserted her as she lost the first set in just 26 minutes, hitting only three winners and making 14 unforced errors. messages.text: Gurney called up to World Series Finals after withdrawals due to visa issues

metadata.summary: Daryl Gurney has been called up to play at the World Series of Darts Finals in Amsterdam after visa issues led to the withdrawal of Philippines players Lourence Ilagan and Alexis Toylo from the September 17-20 event.
metadata.content: World Series of Darts Finals: 2026 schedule and results with Luke Littler, Luke Humphries, Michael van Gerwen, Gian van Veen in action | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to content World Series of Darts Finals: 2026 schedule and results with Luke Littler, Luke Humphries, Michael van Gerwen, Gian van Veen in action A top prize of £100,000 will be up for grabs at the 2026 World Series of Darts Finals featuring a blockbuster 32-player field, with tournament to commence on September 17 in Amsterdam Wednesday 9 September 2026 19:43, UK Image: Daryl Gurney will play reigning champion Michael van Gerwen in round one Daryl Gurney has been called up to play at the World Series of Darts Finals in Amsterdam after visa issues led to the withdrawal of Philippines players Lourence Ilagan and Alexis Toylo from the September 17-20 event. Northern Ireland's Gurney and the Netherlands' Maik Kuivenhoven were the highest-ranked players on the reserve list and have replaced Ilagan and Toylo respectively after the pair did not receive a decision on their Schengen visa applications before having to travel to China this week for the final two events of the PDC Asian Tour season. Gurney will face reigning tournament champion and home favourite Michael van Gerwen in the first round at AFAS Live on Thursday September 17, while Kuivenhoven plays Jonny Clayton the following day.
